title: Human-machine collaboration processes for AI-enabled product design with expert intervention: an example from research vessel design
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This study explores human-machine collaboration in AI-enabled product design, focusing on research vessel design. It proposes an AIPD paradigm grounded in designers' tacit knowledge and outlines four phases: design preparation, large language model training, collaborative design, and knowledge base establishment. The study emphasizes the role of designers in leveraging AI for creative tasks while addressing challenges in AI's understanding of tacit knowledge.
